sources.author: byehi98
patch_list: The "watch a video" buttons give you the reward straight away. Tap one and the cash, gold or bonus is yours — no video, no waiting, and the buttons are always ready to use.
Everything in the shop is free. Tap a cash pack, a gold pack, a car pack or the Livery Creator Pass and you get it straight away — no payment screen, no charge.
Stops banners, roadside billboards and full-screen ads from appearing. Races and menus carry on as normal — the ads just never show up.
